newsitem.title: BURUNDI: At least 26 killed in south Burundi fighting.
newsitem.headline: At least 26 killed in south Burundi fighting.

text.p: At least 26 people were killed in southern Burundi in fighting between the army and rebels, an army spokesman said on Tuesday.
The fighting took place on Monday at Kajondi in Rutavu commune, about 75 km (45 km) southeast of the capital.
The spokesman said the dead included two civilians, four soldiers and at least 20 rebels.

The army has blamed a recent spate of attacks in southern Burundi on the Forces for the Defence of Democracy, a Hutu group fighting to overthrow the Tutsi-dominated government which came to power after a military coup last year.
The aid agency International Medical Corps (IMC) evacuated its staff from southern Burundi on Sunday after heavy fighting between the army and the Hutu rebels, aid officials said.
